rule: date.isocalendar() gives the ISO week-numbering year, the week and the weekday. years: each year 1900 to 2200 with date(year, 12, 28).isocalendar().week (the number of weeks in that year) and date.fromisocalendar(year, 1, 1) (the Monday that starts week 1). dates, boundaries and extremes: [ISO date, week-numbering year, week, weekday].
